prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE landscape 3:2 concept cover for a child's achievable browser-based science project called 'My first molecular observation'. This is a warmer alternative to intimidating laboratory machinery. The attached image is ONLY the accurate molecular-structure reference taken from the actual course; preserve its caffeine atom connectivity and grey-green carbon / blue nitrogen / red-orange oxygen / ivory hydrogen color relationships. Do not copy the reference's pedestal or rectangular UI background. Art direction: a sophisticated warm natural-science editorial cover, true photographic texture plus a beautiful scientific close-up, inviting curiosity without looking like a toy or a school worksheet. Main composition: a real small fresh tea shoot with two or three finely serrated tea leaves rests naturally on warm ivory paper over a light oak home-study table, with exceptionally convincing leaf veins, subtle leaf translucency, and gentle natural side daylight. At the right, a large borderless softly framed molecular-scale scientific illustration window, integrated as editorial artwork on the warm paper background, showing the SAME caffeine molecular model from the reference in clean dimensional detail. A hairline connection from one leaf to the molecular illustration communicates exploring the invisible world of an everyday living thing; the illustration is clearly a scientific visualization, NOT a solid model physically sitting on the leaf or table, NOT a glass magnifier or floating hologram. Near the lower foreground is a modest personal observation card, a small thumbnail view of the same molecule with ONE orange atom marker and one tiny handwritten circle indicating the child's discovery. The card's only readable text is '我的发现'. Add just one ordinary colored pencil next to the card to suggest ownership and thinking; no clutter, no decorative science props. The subject is something a child can OBSERVE, MARK and KEEP in a digital project, not perform chemical extraction. Keep the molecule and leaf strong and clear in a 16:9 card crop, generous breathing room, cream / sage green / subtle coral palette, real material textures, soft dimensional shadows, gentle editorial energy. No people, computer operator, microscope, analytical machinery, medicine, bottles, balance, brass props, plastic molecule toy, candy colors, stickers, badges, fake charts, invented experimental readings, logos, watermark, big title, or fantasy effects. This image is a concept illustration for the project, not student evidence.
reference_role: Actual caffeine model captured from the course; no student submission or account data.
